description: Gisement éolien en mer posé is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. the offshore wind field installed corresponds to the interpolation of the wind and bathymetry criteria: Wind speed 7 m.s-1 AND 0<bathymetry<30m (Atlantic Channel facade) or 0<bathymetry<40m (Mediterranean) Criteria made available by the Renewable Energy Union in 2007 and updated in October 2011. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Offshore wind deposit" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include gisement, eolien fixé. The listing shows 2011-10-03 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
